headline: School Committee to review field trip requests, policy updates, and hold disciplinary hearings for two students.
summary: The meeting covers field trip requests to Ecology School and Saint Anselm/Southern New Hampshire University, several policy reviews and votes, and reports on special education, multilingual programs, NWEA scores, and nutrition funding. The committee will also enter executive session for two student disciplinary hearings and a personnel matter.
items: Consent agenda: transactions, minutes, personnel, and policies (JFABD, BEB, BEA, BDG, BDF, BDD)
Vote on field trip request to Ecology School in Saco, Maine
Vote on field trip request to Saint Anselm and Southern New Hampshire University in Manchester, NH
Policy review: procedure for code of ethics violations
First read and possible vote on policies: BCA-R, BCB, BCC, BDE, BDE-R
Executive session for Student A disciplinary hearing, with possible vote
Executive session for Student B disciplinary hearing, with possible vote
Executive session for a personnel matter, with possible vote
location: The Green Ladle, 156 East Ave., Lewiston
plain_text:
** AGENDA** 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING SCHEDULED FOR MONDAY, OCTOBER 19, 2026 
AT THE GREEN LADLE, 156 EAST AVE., LEWISTON 
Note:  
*A review of all general session meetings can be located at www.lewistonpublicschools.org or copies can be requested at a cost of 10 
cents per page.   
**This Agenda includes estimated time for each agenda item which is being used only as a guide to keep the meeting on schedule. 
***Video Notice: This meeting is being recorded and can be viewed on the internet from a link at www.lewistonpublicschools.org 
 
1. Call meeting to order on or about 5:30 pm until approximately 8:30. Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
2. School Committee Member Introductions. 
 
Moment of Silence for those we have lost recently. Our best thoughts go out to them, their families, friends, 
and loved ones. 
 
3. Consent Agenda: (a) Transactions (b) Minutes (c) Personnel (d) Policies 
i. JFABD -Education of Homeless Students 
ii. BEB -School Committee Members Use of Social Media 
iii. BEA -School Committee use of Electronic Mail 
iv. BDG -School Attorney/Legal Services 
v. BDF -School Committee Advisory Committees 
vi. BDD -School Committee-Superintendent Relationship 
 
4. Public Input: (Note: Members of the public may address the School Committee for up to 3 minutes on non-agenda 
items now and on agenda items later. Speakers must adhere to our public comment policy (BEDH), which is 
available in the back of the room or on the LPS website. These meetings exist to conduct school committee business. 
The purpose of public comment is to share thoughts on school and educational matters. Committee members and 
school staff will not reply during this time. Comments must be directed to the Chair and be civil. By law, comments 
may not pertain to specific staff or students; comments about individuals must be directed privately to the 
appropriate LPS staff. Student privacy must be maintained. The public comment period is 30 minutes unless 
extended due to unusual circumstances. Priority goes to Lewiston residents and parents, students, or employees of 
LPS. Before starting, please state your name, town/city of residence, and affiliation to LPS. 
 
5. To receive and potentially vote on the field trip request to attend Ecology School in Saco, Maine. 
 
6. To receive and potentially vote on the field trip request to attend Saint Anselm and Southern New Hampshire 
University in Manchester, NH. 
 
7. To receive the Special Education Annual Update. 
 
8. To receive the Multilingual Board Report. 
 
9. To receive the NWEA Scores and Goals Dashboard. 
 
10. To receive Nutrition Funding Update.
11. Policy: Review procedure for code of ethics violations. 
 
12. To review and potentially vote on the 1st read of the following policies: 
a. BCA-R - School Committee Concern Procedure 
b. BCB -School Committee Member Conflict of Interest  
c. BCC -Nepotism 
d. BDE -School Committee Standing Committees 
e. BDE-R -Standing Committee Operating Procedures 
 
13. Superintendent Evaluation Process Review. 
 
14. Report from School Committee Chair. 
 
15. Report from School Superintendent. 
 
16. Report from the City Council Rep. 
 
17. Updates from School Committee Subcommittees. 
 
18. School Committee Community Announcements.  
 
19. Future agenda items. 
 
20. To enter into executive session to conduct Student A disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)]. 
 
21. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
22. To enter into executive session to conduct Student B disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)]. 
 
23. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
24. To enter into executive session to discuss a personnel matter in accordance with 1 M.R.S.A. §405(6)(A). 
 
25. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
26. Adjourn. 
 
ADA Notice: This school district will accommodate members of the public with special needs to participate fully in this 
meeting. Please contact Executive Assistant Cheryl Cornelio (795-4100, Ext.4002) if you have such needs.
